displayName: OCI-AI-PD-019: AI — Context Window Overflow Attack
description:
Detects context window overflow attacks designed to push safety instructions out of scope

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_pd_019", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%context%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%window%') AND "value" > 0
